description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Awoken Grand Mace], [Damage Cap +10000] [100% Critical (25s) Custom Param] and [Sheer Determination Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Grand Mace
description.text: Heavy abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Heavy abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Gaia Charge after using Heavy abilities

description.name: Sheer Determination Mode
description.text: Grants [Instant Cast 1] and [Critical Damage +50% 1] after using three Heavy abilities, removed after triggering
